verdict.rationale: OpenCode can hand tasks off asynchronously through its GitHub integration: mentioning /opencode or /oc makes it run the task inside a GitHub Actions runner, work on a new branch and open a PR. It can also run headless via `opencode serve` on a remote backend that clients attach to. Both routes need your own CI or self-hosted infrastructure rather than a first-party managed cloud sandbox. missing for 10: a first-party hosted isolated cloud execution environment, documented background task queue/monitoring for long-running jobs, and independent corroboration of reliability for long tasks run this way.
